Hi,

How are you all?

I have an app that I created according to the information provided by [make.com](https://www.make.com/en/help/apps/communication/zoom--v2-).

The app is set at the Account Level and works just fine - But I cannot use the connection to get meeting participant reports with [this API command](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/methods/#operation/reportMeetingParticipants) \- because I’m getting error 404.

As far as I understand I need to have this scope: report:read:admin that I don’t have now in my app - so I want to add it to the scops I added when created the app - but I see no way to edit the app scops…

Is there a way to add / change scopes in the OAuth app I created?

If so - how?

Thanks!

Ram
